knowledge_base: Search engines apply query rewriting before retrieval to expand synonyms and correct spelling for better recall.
Authoritative domains for software topics include python.org, docs.python.org, peps.python.org, pypi.org, and packaging.python.org.
Freshness windows narrower than 24 hours often return no results because indexing latency commonly exceeds that.
Deduplication by registered domain (not full host) avoids leaking three results from the same site under subdomains.
Result snippets should be truncated at 240 characters with an ellipsis to keep tool output cheap and readable.
Boolean operators AND, OR, and NOT are supported by most engines but must be UPPERCASE; site: and filetype: are also widely supported.
When a query is a question, prefer pages whose title also looks like a question; they are usually FAQs or Q&A.
Always preserve the user query verbatim in the tool log so a reviewer can re-run the same search later.
Throttle searches to one per second to stay below most public search-API rate limits and avoid 429 errors.
Cache results by (query, freshness_window) for 10 minutes; cache hits should be reported as cached=true in the response.

templates.clarify_question: Your query '{q}' is ambiguous — did you mean {a} or {b}?
templates.no_results: No results for '{q}' within freshness {f}; broaden the window or rephrase.
